meta_description: Higgins Glazing & Locks in Leeds provides emergency locksmith services, lock repairs, and glazing solutions. Fast response times, trusted local service.
hero_subhead: Locked out or broken lock in Leeds? Our emergency team arrives within 45 minutes, any time of day or night.
services_subhead: From emergency lock-outs and broken locks to window repairs and glazing installations, we solve your security and access problems fast.

services.title: Emergency Lock-Out
services.desc: Locked out of your home or business? We attend within 45 minutes and open your door without damage. Available 24/7 with no call-out charge.

services.title: Lock Repair & Replacement
services.desc: Broken or faulty locks repaired or replaced same day. We fit high-security locks for doors, windows, and gates to protect your property.

services.title: Broken Window Glass
services.desc: Smashed or cracked window? We replace broken panes and boarding for safety and weather protection. Emergency repairs available round the clock.

services.title: Glazing Installation
services.desc: New window and door glass fitted by experienced glaziers. We supply and install sealed units, toughened glass, and cat flaps with precision.

services.title: Cylinder & Mortice Locks
services.desc: Professional fitting of cylinder locks, mortice locks, and multi-point locking systems for doors and gates. Insurance-approved specifications.

services.title: Security Upgrades
services.desc: Improve your home or business security with our lock upgrades, reinforced hinges, and anti-tamper hardware. Free assessment available.

about_pullquote: We answer the phone within seconds because we know an emergency doesn't wait.
about_para_1: Higgins Glazing & Locks has been protecting Leeds homes and businesses for over 15 years. Founded on the principle of reliability and speed, we've built our reputation by showing up when we say we will—and fixing the problem right first time. Our team carry full stocks of locks, glass, and fittings on every vehicle, so most jobs are completed the same day.
about_para_2: Customers trust us because we charge fairly, don't waste time, and treat your property with respect. We work with landlords, letting agents, and property managers across Leeds, and we're trusted by local police for lock-out support. Whether you're locked out at midnight or need a security upgrade, you'll speak to a real person who knows your area.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Locked myself out on a Friday night and panicked. Called Higgins and a locksmith was at my door in 40 minutes. Very professional, got me back inside without any damage, and the cost was exactly what he'd quoted. Can't fault it.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had a broken window after a break-in attempt. Called at 11pm and they came out within the hour, boarded it up, and came back the next day to fit new glass. Felt safe again straight away. Brilliant service.
reviews.author: Rebecca H.

reviews.text: Used them for an emergency lock repair at my rental property. The team arrived on time, fixed the issue in minutes, and gave me a competitive quote for upgrading the locks. Will definitely use them again.
reviews.author: David M.
